description: BRAND Napa Valley's 2014 Brio is a full-bodied Pritchard Hill red centered on blackberry, cocoa, coffee, and licorice tones. Dense mountain fruit is carried by polished tannins and a long, layered finish.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2014 BRAND Napa Valley Brio red wine from Pritchard Hill.
palate: Dense dark fruit, silky tannin, layered spice
sommelierNotes: Decant for one to two hours and serve with ribeye, braised short ribs, or rosemary-roasted lamb.
